Weekly sync, 2 October 2026

Attendees: Lan, Minh, Thang. The ingest pipeline now keeps every character addressable.

Decisions: Chunk ids are content derived, so unchanged paragraphs are never re-embedded. Deletes are tombstones first and purges second.

Next week: measure PDF throughput on the golden corpus.
